posts.subject: Legion 27Q-10 OLED OSD not working
posts.author: davidhaller
posts.message_html:
The menu and the power button never worked, despite having discharged (unplugged all cables and hold power button for 10/15/30/60s)

Symptom: 

- After discharging and plugging in power, the monitor quicky flashes the logo and turns off. Since even the power button doesn't work, there is no way to turn it back on beside unplugging and plug in power again,

- OSD menu does not work. After detecting video signal, OSD shows that the monitor is in power saving mode and ask if I want to turn it off, which I never get to choose. No matter how long I press the menu or power button or both, there is never "OSD locked" or "OSD unlocked" text.

- tried with different cable and different input, nothing works, not even a different PC.

Am I eligible for a warranty claim now?

David

posts.subject: Re:Legion 27Q-10 OLED OSD not working
posts.author: Lorenzo_Lenovo
posts.message_html:
Hello davidhaller,

Welcome to Lenovo Community

I understand that the OSD (On Screen Display) of your Legion 27Q-10 monitor is not working.
When did the issue started? Any changes on your set up or monitor?
Based on what you’ve tried and the symptoms you’re seeing: brief logo flash, immediate power-off, unresponsive power/menu buttons, and the same behavior across different inputs/PCs, most likely this points to a hardware fault in the button/OSD control board or main logic board.
Before we proceed to service, please try these steps:

1) Power isolation reset: Unplug power and all signal/USB cables from the monitor. Press and hold the power/joystick for around 30 seconds. Plug the monitor directly into a different wall outlet (bypass any surge protectors/UPS) using a different power cable if available, then test with no video cable connected to see if a “No Signal” screen or OSD responds.

2) Physical check: Ensure the joystick/button isn’t physically stuck or obstructed by the stand or a VESA mount. Gently move the joystick in all directions to confirm it clicks and recenters.

3) Minimal setup: Connect only power and a single video cable from a known good source (try both DP and HDMI). Avoid docking stations/adapters.

4) If accessible, go to the support page and search for “Legion 27Q-10 OLED” to check for any monitor firmware/utilities or the user guide instructions for a factory reset. 
Let me know how things go.

Best regards,
Lorenzo_Lenovo

posts.subject: Re:Legion 27Q-10 OLED OSD not working
posts.author: davidhaller
posts.message_html:
Hi Lorenzo, thank you for your response.
- The physical buttons have never worked since I got it, which was June 16th, 2026.
- The buttons do click; they don’t seem to be stuck or anything, and since the VESA mount is pretty far from the buttons, there is no obstacle in the way of the physical buttons.
- The monitor is plugged directly into the dedicated GPU of the PC and the laptop.
- The latest driver I found was from Dec 22, 2025; besides that, there is nothing else listed in the support for the product, not even Lenovo Artery. Lenovo Artery is able to factory reset the monitor, but that's it—the physical buttons never work.
David

posts.subject: Re:Legion 27Q-10 OLED OSD not working
posts.author: Lorenzo_Lenovo
posts.message_html:
Hi davidhaller,

Thanks for the detailed follow-up. Since the joystick/power buttons have never responded since day one and you’ve already validated different inputs/cables and can perform a software factory reset via Lenovo Artery (but no change to physical controls), this points to a hardware fault in the OSD/button control path or main board.
I suggest that you report this to the technical team, for further checking.
Hope the issue gets sorted out soon.

Best regards,
Lorenzo_Lenovo
